verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no n8n statement, policy, or setting about whether customer or workflow data is used to train AI models, and no opt-out control. Self-hosting, 'support for sensitive data', and connecting to local or open-source models (e.g. Ollama) are adjacent deployment choices and user-side arrangements, not a documented training-data protection, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
